name: Ловля фігури (3)
description: Pieces want as much mobility as possible. When the mobility of a piece is restricted, it risks being trapped. Trapped pieces have no escape squares. By attacking them, you can win material.

examples.text: The black queen has limited mobility, and with a clever rook move, it is lost. Note that this is the only rook move that works, as it also takes away the escape square d2.

examples.pgn: {[#]} 9... c4 {[%csl Rb3,Gc4][%cal Gc4b3]} 10. Ba4 b5 {[%csl Ra4,Yb3,Gb5][%cal Gb5a4]} 11. Bxb5 axb5 *
examples.text: After two clever pawn moves, the white bishop suddenly finds itself trapped.

texts: Pieces with limited mobility can be trapped.
